title: Buying Mountain Land in NC: What to Check First
excerpt: Buying land or mountain property in the High Country of NC takes more than a quick drive-by and a good feeling. Here is what every buyer should check before making an offer in Boone, Valle Crucis, or anywhere in Watauga County.
